name: Valproic Acid
summary: Valproic acid (brand names include Depakene) is a seizure medicine that works against many seizure types, and is also used as a mood stabilizer in bipolar disorder and to prevent migraines.
description: Valproic acid, sold under brand names such as Depakene, is a seizure medicine that works against many types of seizures. It is also effective as a mood stabilizer in bipolar disorder and for preventing migraines. It works by boosting GABA, the brain's main calming chemical, and by calming overactive nerve signals (through sodium and T-type calcium channels). It comes as a medicine taken by mouth and as an IV form.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Valproic acid, marketed under brand names such as Depakene, is an antiepileptic drug with broad-spectrum activity against many seizure types. It is also effective as a mood stabilizer in bipolar disorder and in the prevention of migraines. Its mechanism involves enhancing gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) activity, modulating voltage-gated sodium channels, and inhibiting T-type calcium channels. It is available in oral and intravenous formulations.
